technical.summary: TSLA shows strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive momentum indicators, but overbought conditions (RSI 9, Stoch) and weak ADX trend strength create pullback risk; better suited for scaling into weakness than aggressive entry at current levels.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 30 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: low — mixed signals, small to medium amounts, junior members
sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (VIX-equivalent 17) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and stale (94+ days old), with no recent conviction from senior members.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (287.84) indicates extreme market stress, FOMC decision in 2 days adds binary event risk, and earnings in 30 days creates additional volatility exposure for discretionary sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with Ichimoku tenkan-kijun cross-up and new 20-day highs provide bullish structure, while extreme fear (VIX crisis) and contrarian sentiment present asymmetric risk/reward for contrarian entry.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought RSI (78.86) and Stochastic (90.86) combined with weak ADX (14.55), inverted yield curve, FOMC decision in 2 days, earnings in 30 days, and zero fundamental conviction create excessive event risk and exhaustion signals that outweigh technical strength.

decision.entry_rationale: While extreme fear sentiment and contrarian positioning offer asymmetric upside, overbought technicals (RSI 78.86, Stoch 90.86) combined with weak trend strength (ADX 14.55) and imminent FOMC decision create excessive near-term pullback risk that outweighs entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: FOMC decision in 2 days and earnings in 30 days create binary event risk in a macro environment with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels; overbought conditions likely to trigger mean reversion before any contrarian rally materializes.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical exhaustion, weak fundamentals, and macro headwinds override contrarian sentiment opportunity
